purpose: The client answers the aesthetic questionnaire. Asked in the SAME sitting as the PRD interview questions, so it is not a third interruption. The lane refuses to generate any concept before these exist; tone and manner come from here, not from the design systems.

inputContract.notes: questionnaire.questions[] from stage 08, asked with AskUserQuestion (colour first).

questions.question: 청첩장 화면을 어떤 색깔로 하면 좋을까요?

outputContract.notes: A map keyed by question id. integrate.mjs rejects keys the lane never asked and refuses to proceed while any question is unanswered.

handoff.via: Passed verbatim as args.clientPreferences; also hashed into the concepts stage fingerprint, so changing an answer invalidates the generated concepts.
